description:

1. Migrate the remaining ~8 unit tests that use MockBackend's fault/override knobs to use FaultyBackend.
2. Delete src/lib.rs:124-458 (test_support::MockBackend module).
3. Audit src/lib.rs:486-552 unit tests (the ones in src/lib.rs itself) for MockBackend usage and migrate them too.
4. Update README.md:239-241 — the 'A tree-backed MockBackend exists in the test_support module' line is stale.

Verify: cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server passes, no more 'MockBackend' identifier anywhere in the crate (grep should be empty).
title: filenode-server: migrate fault-injection unit tests + delete test_support module + update README
